risks.rationale: The tooling contract supports per-module security records before every standalone repository has published a row.
risks.mitigation: Absent rows are not interpreted as passing verdicts; adoption remains explicit and risk-proportional.
risks.review_condition: Review when a repository adopts the security record contract, before the next ecosystem milestone, or by 2026-11-09; the deferred bounded fleet audits remain required after the substantive-delivery review checkpoint.
